capabilities: Adjust background, link, text, and accent colors
Set typography, heading, list, and spacing values
Maintain separate light and dark profiles
Manage color palettes and assign colors to settings
Export settings as a CSS snippet
disambiguation: Not a theme; it is a settings panel for customizing appearance and exporting CSS.
extras: Intended mainly for the default theme; community themes and custom CSS snippets may interfere. Exported CSS snippets let users keep customizations after removing the plugin.
intentEvidence: without the need to write custom CSS snippets
problem: Changing Obsidian's colors, text sizes, and spacing normally requires writing custom CSS snippets.
summary: Settings UI for changing Obsidian's colors, typography, spacing, and other appearance details, with light/dark profiles and CSS export.
